description: This line plot illustrates the performance of five different methods evaluated across varying ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" and employs a linear scale with visible numeric tick marks ranging from 19 to 23 at intervals of 1. The plot contains five solid lines, all featuring circular markers. The blue line, representing "TrajICL," exhibits a steady decline from approximately 20.4 at an x-value of 0.1 to roughly 18.1 at an x-value of 1.0, passing through intermediate values of 19.2 at x=0.3 and 18.6 at x=0.5. The orange line, labeled "Head Tuning," starts at approximately 23.0, dips slightly to 22.5 at x=0.5, rises to 22.7 at x=0.7, and ends at 22.6. The green line, representing "FT," begins at 22.2, drops to 21.7 at x=0.2, rises to 22.0 at x=0.3, declines to a low of 20.6 at x=0.7 and x=0.9, and finishes at 21.0. The red line, denoted as "LoRA 16," starts at 23.0 and shows a gradual decrease, reaching 22.3 at x=0.5 and ending at 22.2. Finally, the purple line, labeled "LoRA 64," follows a similar downward trend, starting at 22.9, passing through 22.4 at x=0.5, and concluding at 22.1 at an x-value of 1.0.
